denominator_rule: Charts use valid responses; Not answered is displayed separately with total interview counts.

limitations.aggregate_coexistence: Separate overall measures do not by themselves show that the same individuals held each view.
limitations.perception_not_forecast: Perceived election-related violence risk is an opinion, not a forecast of whether violence will occur.
limitations.survey_coverage: Results describe respondents in surveyed locations and should not be read as national population estimates.
limitations.not_answered: The source combines unanswered cases; it does not distinguish refusal, routing, skipped questions or other absence.
